title: Chosun Expo - the front company behind the hacks

scenes.narration: [serious] U.S. officials say a normal-looking company hid a secret.
It was called Chosun Expo. It worked from an office in China.
On the outside, it made games and betting apps for customers around the world.
But officials say it was really linked to a spy unit of North Korea's army.
Worker Park Jin Hyok was there over ten years. He went home in 2014, just before Sony was attacked.
How did they connect him? His own email and a hacker's fake name both used the same three letters.
In 2018, America charged him. The office job, they say, was a mask.

facts.claim: Prosecutors describe Chosun Expo Joint Venture (Korea Expo Joint Venture) as a North Korean government front company with offices in China and the DPRK, affiliated with Lab 110 of DPRK military intelligence; Park worked there for over a decade as a programmer for paying clients worldwide and in malicious cyber activity

Chosun Expo's website called it North Korea's 'first internet company', founded in 2002; a 2015 version said it focused on gaming, gambling, e-payments and image recognition software; it operated out of Dalian, China

Park's email ttykim1018 and the Kim Hyon Woo persona's email tty198410 both contained 'tty' and were in each other's address books; a resume listed Visual C++; Park worked at KEJV until 2014, just before the Sony hack
Park returned to North Korea in 2014
On September 6, 2018 OFAC designated Park Jin Hyok and Korea Expo Joint Venture (aka Chosun Expo)
